sources.title: Contrast Sets for Evaluating Language-Guided Robot Policies
sources.review_scope: Official event CoRL 2024; proceedings published in 2025.
sources.supported_finding: Targeted contrast-set evaluation already exists.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Not evidence of post-RL retention under matched initial states.

sources.title: What Can RL Bring to VLA Generalization? An Empirical Study
sources.review_scope: arXiv v4 sections 4 and 5.1–5.3; not complete final-version diff.
sources.supported_finding: Semantic and multi-object/receptacle generalization under RL are already studied.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Cannot claim that RL language generalization has not been evaluated.

sources.title: RL's Razor: Why Online Reinforcement Learning Forgets Less
sources.review_scope: arXiv v1 section B.2 and experiment summary; final-version differences pending.
sources.supported_finding: At matched acquisition RL retains prior capabilities better; robot study adapts can manipulation and evaluates drawer tasks.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Strong counterevidence to assumed RL forgetting; KL and RL-vs-SFT retention are not new.

sources.title: Pretrained Vision-Language-Action Models are Surprisingly Resistant to Forgetting in Continual Learning
sources.review_scope: Abstract only this turn.
sources.supported_finding: Pretraining and simple experience replay are strong retention baselines.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Does not establish the outcome of our unexecuted comparison.

sources.title: Breaking Lock-In: Preserving Steerability under Low-Data VLA Post-Training
sources.review_scope: v1 sections 3.1–3.3; official acceptance not verified.
sources.supported_finding: Low-data SFT lock-in, visual grounding preservation and contrastive prompt guidance are direct prior work.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Replacing SFT with RL does not establish an independent contribution.

sources.title: TEMPO: Semantic-Action Decoupled RL Post-Training for Vision-Language-Action Models
sources.review_scope: v1 sections IV-A/B; official acceptance not verified.
sources.supported_finding: Frozen VLM with separate semantic projection/action-expert RL updates.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Freezing semantic modules or separate update rates is not new.

sources.title: When Vision Overrides Language: Evaluating and Mitigating Counterfactual Failures in VLAs
sources.review_scope: Author project and code README; official venue endpoint not established.
sources.supported_finding: LIBERO-CF and CAG already test alternate feasible instructions and counterfactual guidance.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Focused suite removes a training target; do not treat it as unchanged-scene intervention.

sources.title: CounterAlign: Counterfactual Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Models
sources.publication_status: CoRL (existing registry status; current official endpoint unavailable)
sources.review_scope: Official forum access failed this turn; v1 section 3 and Appendix 6 read.
sources.supported_finding: Instruction/action relabeling, ambiguity filtering and offline advantage-weighted policy learning are direct prior work.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Unmatched instructions are not automatically valid negative actions.

sources.title: Restoring Linguistic Grounding in VLA Models via Train-Free Attention Recalibration
sources.review_scope: Publisher abstract read; no complete method audit.
sources.supported_finding: Contradictory instructions and train-free attention recalibration are already studied.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Not executing an impossible instruction differs from completing a different valid goal.

sources.title: Embodied Interpretability: Linking Causal Understanding to Generalization in Vision-Language-Action Models
sources.review_scope: Abstract only this turn.
sources.supported_finding: Visual intervention and irrelevant-region diagnostics connect interpretation to generalization.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Internal scores alone are not evidence of retained closed-loop behavior.

sources.title: RLinf-VLA: A Unified and Efficient Framework for Reinforcement Learning of Vision-Language-Action Models
sources.review_scope: GitHub HEAD metadata additionally checked; no runtime check.
sources.supported_finding: Public VLA RL framework is a potential implementation starting point.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Availability does not prove model/backend compatibility or local GPU sufficiency.

sources.title: Real-Time Execution of Action Chunking Flow Policies
sources.review_scope: Abstract only this turn.
sources.supported_finding: Asynchronous action-chunk execution already exists.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Not a new contribution to add an asynchronous execution wrapper.

sources.title: Learning High-Frequency Continuous Action Chunks in Latent Space
sources.review_scope: RTR GitHub HEAD metadata checked; no execution.
sources.supported_finding: High-frequency latent chunks and reuse/refine execution are direct prior work.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Within-episode interval-change coverage needs body/code comparison.

sources.title: Trajectory-Level Continuous Action Representation for Robotic Manipulation
sources.review_scope: Publisher metadata and abstract; arXiv abstract also checked.
sources.supported_finding: CAT represents fixed real-time trajectories with frequency-aware encoding.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Generic physical-time conditioning and multi-rate representation are already addressed.

sources.title: PaceVLA: Adaptive Temporal Action Quantization in Vision-Language-Action Models
sources.review_scope: v2 abstract; official acceptance not verified.
sources.supported_finding: Adaptive coarse/fine temporal quantization is prior work.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Does not establish a remaining timing gap by itself.

sources.title: Same Path, Less Time: Training-Free Fast Execution of Vision-Language-Action Models under Inference Latency
sources.review_scope: Submitted November 2026; abstract only; official acceptance not verified.
sources.supported_finding: Frozen-policy path-preserving time scaling is a strong simple alternative.
sources.interpretation_boundary: No real-robot or causal effect claim beyond the abstract.

sources.title: LIBERO-RIG: A Hardware-Setup Robustness Benchmark for Vision-Language-Action Models
sources.review_scope: Abstract only; official acceptance not verified.
sources.supported_finding: Control-rate and hardware-setup robustness are already benchmarked.
sources.interpretation_boundary: A new set of setup perturbations alone is not an established contribution.

sources.title: RoboMME: Benchmarking and Understanding Memory for Robotic Generalist Policies
sources.review_scope: Abstract only this turn.
sources.supported_finding: Memory evaluation across task categories and policy designs already exists.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Generic memory augmentation/evaluation is not an uncovered gap.

sources.title: ActMem-VLA: Action-History Memory with Dual-Expert Denoising for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Policies
sources.review_scope: v2, October 12; official acceptance not verified.
sources.supported_finding: Action-history memory and dual-expert denoising are prior work.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Command history is not automatically proof of completed physical outcomes.

sources.title: Is Your Robot's Memory Just a Clock? Temporal Shortcuts in Memory-Augmented VLA Policies
sources.review_scope: v1 submitted November 10; full body not reviewed.
sources.supported_finding: Null pauses/fidgets expose phantom progress; event indexing is already proposed.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Do not claim temporal shortcuts or event-indexed memory as a new topic.

sources.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
sources.review_scope: Event CoRL 2024; proceedings published 2025.
sources.supported_finding: Public VLA foundation and fine-tuning starting point.
sources.interpretation_boundary: 7B availability is not proof of single-GPU RL feasibility.

sources.title: Stable Language Guidance for Vision–Language–Action Models
sources.review_scope: Official Anthology abstract/metadata checked.
sources.supported_finding: Semantic expansion and residual steering are strong language-grounding alternatives.
sources.interpretation_boundary: Inference improvements do not establish post-training retention or equal inference cost.

n1_review.decision: Integrate as a scoped follow-up analysis within unified_vla_rl; do not create an independent methods dossier. Preserve U1 estimand and runtime contract.

direct_prior_reviews.title: RL's Razor
direct_prior_reviews.review_scope: Final proceedings sections 3–5, Appendix A and C.2 (printed pp.22–23); selected passages, not full proof/version audit.
direct_prior_reviews.finding: Can-to-drawer robot setting persists in final version. Forward-KL empirical predictor and reverse-KL theorem have distinct directions; simplified theory does not guarantee arbitrary deep robot behavior.
direct_prior_reviews.boundary: Third-party MNIST reproduction not substituted for robot implementation.

direct_prior_reviews.title: DeLock
direct_prior_reviews.review_scope: Sections 3–4, Appendix A/C and author project page.
direct_prior_reviews.finding: Direct concept/spatial lock-in, visual drift regularization, prompt guidance and frozen-visual ablation.
direct_prior_reviews.boundary: Algorithm text reviewed; implementation not available through inspected author link.

direct_prior_reviews.title: TEMPO
direct_prior_reviews.review_scope: Sections III and IV-B, including Table IV task-set ablation.
direct_prior_reviews.finding: Already varies selected training task sets 1/2/4/7/34 under five-subtask rollouts; broad goal-coverage comparison is not new.
direct_prior_reviews.access_result: HTML application shell; attempted public metadata API returned HTTP 403. No authenticated or alternate access bypass attempted.
direct_prior_reviews.boundary: Do not infer not released, verified source implementation, or exact same-scene retention coverage.

direct_prior_reviews.title: CounterAlign
direct_prior_reviews.review_scope: Sections 3.2–3.3 and Appendix 2/6; author research page.
direct_prior_reviews.finding: Ambiguity-aware relabeling and likelihood-free advantage-weighted flow objective. Do not treat action-vector changes as policy KL.
direct_prior_reviews.publication_boundary: Existing registry CoRL status preserved. OpenReview forum unavailable; API2 request HTTP403 this turn.
